module: Reading and writing of a vehicle's thumbnail configuration (thumbnailConfig key): it is stored in /vehicles/<model>/info_<config>.json for a configuration, and in /vehicles/<model>/info.json for the model. It notably contains rotation (degrees, rotation of the camera frame around the vertical axis), pauseDelay (seconds of waiting before capture) and saved cameras (configCamEnabled, modelCamEnabled). The module also provides the vehicle's reference axes (level and oriented according to the rotation) and the camera offset <-> vehicle frame conversions used to save and replay a camera.
notes: A config's configuration takes priority over the model's for rotation and pauseDelay; default values 0.
getCameraConfig returns vehCamConfig = {configCamEnabled = false, modelCamEnabled = false} if no thumbnail config exists for the config.
The read functions assume that core_vehicles.getModel(modelName) returns a table; an unknown model can cause a Lua error when accessing modelData.configs.
getLevelAxes straightens the vehicle box's axes to the horizontal (the heading is kept) so that a vehicle tilted at spawn does not tilt the camera.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: core_camera and core_vehicles.

saveVehicleConfig.desc: Saves a configuration's thumbnail config to its info file (known infoFilename, otherwise /vehicles/<model>/info_<config>.json) and updates the in-memory data.

returns.desc: false if the existing file is unreadable or if the write fails.

saveModelConfig.desc: Saves the model's thumbnail config to /vehicles/<model>/info.json and updates the in-memory data.

getCameraConfig.desc: Retrieves the thumbnail configs of a configuration and of its model (rereading the info_<config>.json file if it is not in memory).

getRotation.desc: Returns the camera rotation (in degrees): that of the config, otherwise that of the model, otherwise 0.

getPauseDelay.desc: Returns the wait time before capture in seconds (config, otherwise model, otherwise 0), never negative.

getLevelAxes.desc: Computes orthonormal axes from the vehicle's box: horizontal heading (axis 1), world right and up.

getReferenceAxes.desc: Returns the vehicle's reference axes for the camera: axes straightened by getLevelAxes, rotated by -rotation degrees around the vertical axis if a rotation is configured.

getCameraOffsets.desc: Converts the current camera's position and orientation into offsets relative to the vehicle (in its reference axes) so they can be saved.

returns.desc: Position offset in the vehicle frame.
Camera orientation in the vehicle frame.

rewindCameraOffsets.desc: Inverse operation of getCameraOffsets: rebuilds the camera's world position and orientation for the vehicle from saved offsets.
